g.text: Native profiles: t=.85, .90, .95 s; shading is snapshot range, not a confidence interval. Work excludes transport/pressure/time terms.
z spectra retain mode0; null Fourier Nyquist bin omitted from display. Values below 1e-9 are clipped by the display axis. No experimental data loaded.
